technical.summary: Mixed technicals with short-term bullish momentum (RSI, Supertrend, Hull) offset by overbought conditions, weak longer-term structure (below 50/200 MAs), and negative volume signals (CMF, AO) — moderate risk swing entry with limited upside confirmation.

fundamental.summary: STZ shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk with earnings 23 days away.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear state (44 VIX-equivalent) with bearish retail sentiment (45.8%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (251+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (459), flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent FOMC event, and earnings in 23 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for STZ trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI 9, Supertrend, Hull bullish) with price near support (200.762) offers tactical swing entry in fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators, price below 50/200 MAs, negative volume (CMF/AO), zero fundamental conviction, imminent earnings (23 days), and crisis-level VIX (459) in unfavourable macro create excessive risk for minimal upside confirmation.
